Firefox reads exactly ONE policies.json (no merging across files like flatpaks.list.d) and it is machine-scoped, not account-scoped, so with a single image there is one policy for everyone — this is the former svk-student (stricter) policy, kept because applying the stricter of the two fleet-wide is the safe direction. For the FLATPAK Firefox to read it, /etc/firefox is exposed to the sandbox via /etc/flatpak/overrides/org.mozilla.firefox. Full key reference: https://mozilla.github.io/policy-templates/
